result.title: Hybrid AI for AI-Native RAN Control: A Functional Perspective
result.summary: AI-native radio access network (RAN) control involves interdependent decisions across network entities, protocol layers, and timescales. Understanding how AI and conventional methods can jointly support these decisions requires a common basis for comparing their functional roles. This survey introduces a technique-agnostic taxonomy of RAN decision-making organized around four complementary capabilities: Representation and Reasoning, Prediction and Simulation, Adaptive Control, and Decision Synthesis. These capabilities are defined by their roles in the control process, independently of the techniques used to implement them. Through this perspective, we examine representative AI and model-based approaches, including foundation models, world models, reinforcement learning, and optimization. We then apply the taxonomy to representative RAN control solutions across slow, medium, fast, and cross-timescale applications to identify which capabilities they implement and how these capabilities are combined in hybrid AI systems. We also review datasets, benchmarks, simulators, digital twins, and experimental platforms according to their support for the decision-making process and reproducible evaluation. The review highlights a gap between the availability of resources for closed-loop experimentation and the standardization of tasks, metrics, and evaluation protocols needed for meaningful comparisons.Finally, we identify research directions for hybrid AI in AI-native RAN, including capability integration, multi-agent and cross-timescale coordination, constraint handling, and reproducible closed-loop evaluation. A curated list of surveyed works and evaluation resources is available at https://github.com/pegahani/Hybrid-AI-RAN-Survey.

AI.brief_summary: 这篇综述讨论 AI 原生无线接入网（RAN）控制中 AI 与传统方法如何分工，提出一套与技术无关的四能力分类法——表示与推理、预测与仿真、自适应控制、决策综合——并据此梳理基础模型、世界模型、强化学习、优化等方法，以及跨慢/中/快/跨时间尺度方案和数据集、仿真器、数字孪生等评测资源。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按功能角色而非技术在「表示—预测—控制—决策综合」间拆分能力，并指出闭环实验资源与任务、指标、评测协议标准化之间的缺口，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的能力—成本分解与可复现评测设计提供概念参照，具体对应关系仍需核查。
